scientific_integrity: Exact all-odd-prime-power proof with independent exhaustive adjacency enumerators in four small fields. The graph is defined over the rational points, not inferred from geometric porism alone. Same-model scientific review only; no claim of independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordered smooth plane conic pairs of geometric contact type (2,2) in odd characteristic, and to simple rational cyclic polygons. Historical unindexed design/finite-geometry literature may contain an equivalent all-length global enumeration.
title: A universal Poncelet-polygon count for conics with two double contacts
